name: Advanced Header Field
description: A field type for heading text with an optional subtitle.
project_description: This module provides a heading field that allows you to split the semantic meaning of a heading and its visual style. Often times content editors will choose the incorrect tag for proper SEO and A11y because they want a specific visual size. It extends the link field, so that any heading can become a link. You can also provide it additional styles to suit your project’s needs. Another benefit is all data is stored in a single table.
